_comment: What each technique paid at bind time and what a query cost, measured by
the scripts under benchmarks/. Every row within a class comes from one run
on one instance, and every run checks that all its techniques return the same
answers before reporting a time — a row that got faster by getting a
different answer fails the benchmark rather than landing here.
Rerun docs/plot.py after changing anything in this file.
